Normalization: Raw signed native header strings are replayed verbatim: public synthetic key is already base64 encoded and MD5 is explicit; no SDK automatic key encoding assumed. Native bucket names are replaced per scenario. SDK-origin PutBucketPolicy rows supply the existing bodyMD5 recipe after policy resource normalization, preserving required transport integrity. Request IDs, dates, signatures, opaque SSE-C ETags are not compared. SSE-C headers and exact successful object response bytes are compared. Configuration reads project native XML leaf values. TLS=true selects real TLS, not forwarded-proto headers. HTTP encrypted GET is evidence-only because the runner has no mixed per-call transport. Native audit delivery is retained in compressed evidence only.
